title: G1's raw walk record: .private/work/walks/<sha40>/walk.json
description: What web/e2e/real/walk.spec.ts records (docs/specs/factory.md 5 'G1') and scripts/walk/verdict.py judges against .private/work/walk-expect/<set>.json. Private, raw numbers only: file ids are ordinals, kinds and states are the product's enum codes, Disciplines are Library keys; never a file name, a Sheet title or Question text. A smoke walk carries smoke: true and is never judged as a verdict.

project.description: The project the walk made for the set and read with no act (its snapshot.json is the burden; the agent layer walks it).

bulk_project.description: The Project the walk made for the set's bulk count after its gap answers: the same files, read with no act, then each open numbering-gap Question answered once.

confirm_targets.description: Act rounds in the acts Project that found a Sheet offering a single confirm (it agrees, is undecided and no Question holds it). 0: no confirm could be timed; the act check is then not measured (`no_confirm_target`), never failed as slow.

project_acts.description: Step 1 posts (acts, answers) made in `project`, the Project the agent layer walks: always 0; a walk that acted on it is refused.

acts_project.description: The second project the walk made for the set: the same files, read again, acted on while they read.

measures.description: Never written by the walk: scripts/walk/measures.py adds it from snapshot.json (counts only). unmeasured 1: the snapshot could not measure the set, and the other keys are absent.

files.description: Each file in upload order. state: done (read), or the product's end state (failed, held, unreadable, refused, cancelled), or timeout.

acts.description: Each act on Step 1, timed from its key to its answer; read_running only if a file read both before and after it.

questions.description: Open Questions per Discipline key, by the product's Question kind, in the snapshot taken before any act.

burden.description: G5's burden counts per Discipline key, in the snapshot taken before any act. The walk writes false_continuation_questions as null; scripts/walk/measures.py counts every row afresh from snapshot.json and the set's expectation (adding sheets_expected, blank_sheets and machine_doubt_questions), and a set it cannot measure keeps the walk's rows and fails its snapshot checks closed. bulk_confirmable is null where a numbering gap is open and no count was read after its answer.
